name: Electric Fence AP
source: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun
description: A locked, wrought iron fence with bars spaced inches apart is magically electrified.
disable: Crafting or DC 28 Thievery (expert) to disconnect the fence from its magitech power source
reset: The trap automatically resets. If deactivated or disabled, the trap doesn't reset.

offensiveAbilities.name: Shock
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature touches the fence directly or with a tool or weapon

Effect The fence deals 6d12 Electricity Damage damage to the triggering creature (Basic DC 26 Reflex Saving Throw).
